definitions: A part of the trunk or a large branch of a tree that has fallen or been cut off.
An official record of events or a journey.
A device for measuring the speed of a ship or other vessel.
A record of the performance of a computer or other machine.
examples: The fire was fed with a large log.
The captain kept a detailed log of the voyage.
The ship's log indicated a speed of 15 knots.
The system administrator checked the server log for errors.
